text:
Priya: Boreal Labs wants to ingest a custom 30B model for a POC starting next Tue. Need checks: variant compatibility, quant/inf readiness, security questionnaire answers, and a ballpark cost estimate. Anyone who can take lead?

Lena: @Priya can you share model format + tokenizer? Also expected seq length and KV/cache size? :eyes: 

Priya: Sure — link to the tar: s3://boreal-pocs/models/zephyr-30b.tar.gz. Model is LlamaX-30B fp16 (sharded), tokenizer is SentencePiece (v0.1.96). Typical seqs 512-1024, avg 256. KV cache per request ~ 1.6MB for 512 tokens. 

Marco: Ok. Quick things: is the model using RMSNorm or a custom op? Any rematerialization? That affects kernel choices. 

Priya: I checked w/ their infra team: uses RMSNorm and standard attention (no flash attention fused ops). No custom CUDA kernels. 

Marco: Good. For fast onboarding we can try quantizing to 4-bit (nf4) and run an eval with our conversion script. 

Marco: Run this locally to test conversion: 
```
python tools/convert_model.py --input s3://boreal-pocs/models/zephyr-30b.tar.gz \n  --out /tmp/zephyr-nf4 --quant nf4 --tokens vocab.json
```

Evan: For the SLO ask (<=250ms @ 512 tokens) you'll need H100-class or A100x4 with batched concurrency. If they want hosted latency on shared fleet, expect 2x latency. Dedicated pool recommended. 

Priya: Budget ask from the customer: "rough monthly for a POC 5k req/day, burst 10k". Any roughs? 

Evan: For dedicated reserved capacity (H100 w/ 1 replica sized for 5k/day) estimate ~$18k/mo baseline; with canary & autoscale bump maybe $22-25k/mo. Shared hosted path roughly $8-12k/mo with higher tail latency. I'll add write-up. 

Lena: We should offer a fallback 7B variant for cost sensitive flows. We'll note quality tradeoffs in the eval. 

Olivia: Security: we'll need Boreal's security questionnaire filled + DP addendum (if they send data). Also they requested KMS / HSM integration for keys — we can support AWS KMS and a bring-your-own-HSM option. @Priya please share customer legal contact. 

Priya: Legal contact: legal@boreallabs.com. I'll attach the questionnaire PDF after this thread. 

model-scan-bot: Automated model-scan: license check -> OK; tokenizer matches SentencePiece; suspicious externals -> 0. Safety classifier quick-scan -> flagged 1 low-confidence hallucination pattern (manual review recommended). 

Marco: Noted. We'll include a small eval harness with the prompt set to measure hallucination rate. 

Priya: Plan: (1) Marco to run conversion + quick perf by EOD tomorrow, (2) Lena to prepare eval prompt set, (3) Evan to size Dedicated pool & price doc, (4) Olivia to compile SCQ/SOC2 docs request. I'll sync w/ Boreal and schedule a canary for Thu. 

Lena: Acked. I'll also stub a canary runbook with rollback steps. 

Evan: I'll ping infra for instance reservations. 

Olivia: I'll also request their org's SOC2 cert and send prefilled SCQ answers. 

Priya: Thanks team :raised_hands: — will update once I have the questionnaire and the S3 access token for conversion. 

Lena: :thumbsup:
